summary.recommendation: Prioritize playback reliability in the next product cycle: reduce crashes and unexpected stops, prevent unwanted track substitution, and make failure-to-start states diagnosable and recoverable.

evidence.evidenceQuote: If the free version is constantly crashing, why the hell would I ever pay for premium service?!? Don't believe me, do a Google search for "spotify keeps crashing" and see the results. It will play 1 or 2 songs then stop. I tried clearing the cache, uninstalling/ reinstalling, adjusted the data mode, signed in/ out all with no change. Great catalog of music, but can't listen to it without regularly restarting my playlist every 5 -15 minutes. Please fix!!!
Every time I play my favorite song, it plays another song and I hate it.

What a horrible music app to use ,I thought the free version was to entice users to go premium ,but Jesus it does the opposite, I never wanted to delete an app soo badly,You select a song you want to listen too and it LITERALLY plays 6 other different songs,worse you can't even skip them.

recommendation.text: Prioritize playback reliability in the next product cycle: reduce crashes and unexpected stops, prevent unwanted track substitution, and make failure-to-start states diagnosable and recoverable.
